title: AudioVerdicts
description: A listener's verdicts on a course's clips (ADR 0060): written by the web app's audio check, applied to the audio index by `nabu audio verdicts`. A clip judged right is marked reviewed (a clip the round-trip check failed then ships); a clip judged wrong is rejected and stays out of bundles.

AudioVerdict.title: AudioVerdict
AudioVerdict.description: One item's clips as heard: the normal-speed clip and its slow one together, since the round trip checks the item as one.

item.description: Sentence id, KC id for a word, or "<story>#<step>" for a story line.

clips.description: sha256 of each clip heard. A verdict applies only to these: a clip made again since is left alone.

note.description: What is wrong (or anything else worth saying), in the listener's words.
